execution: single-session: 1 batch (playbook 0 step 5: '1 or 2 batches ... run !mongo_unit_migration for each batch here, then !mongo_reconciliation in one fresh session' -> fresh Local subagent as verifier).

batches.brief: Units: shared-reference (CODES, TENANTS, PLANS). Source: Oracle OW_BILLING via secret ORACLE_BILLING_RO_DSN (read-only, concurrency 1). Target: Atlas otterworks-demo database mmp_rt_billing via secret MONGODB_MMP_RT_TARGET_URI; write ONLY to mmp_rt_billing.codes, mmp_rt_billing.tenants, mmp_rt_billing.plans. Mapping: .migration/03_mapping_spec.json v1.0.0 (fields, keys, embeds, canonicalization). Tolerances: .migration/02_tolerances.json v1.0.0 (exact). Fixture manifest: .migration/fixtures/ow_billing.json. Loader: Python oracledb -> pymongo bulk_write (replace, upsert) into the declared collections, idempotent by _id. Recon: `recon run` from repo root, --mode fixture until green, then exactly one --mode live --target-class migration_cluster; merge only on live PASS. Never touch Oracle beyond SELECT; never edit .migration/; open one PR per batch against the run branch.
